description.content:
Use [Contact Enrich](#c145dd01-eb54-4fc2-bbdb-9edc04b7ea1b) to retrieve contact detail using valid query parameters. A Contact Enrich request requires you to specify both input parameters about the contact you are enriching, and the output fields you want to retrieve.

Refer to the examples provided to build a valid JSON request. For supported input and output parameters:

*   Use the [Contact Enrich Inputs](#dbaf31cd-0f7a-4bf3-b6c1-077f3c31f2df) endpoint to retrieve a list of valid input parameters you can provide
*   Use the [Contact Enrich Outputs](#28b47784-3186-4fc4-af91-12e6bc6fb31a) endpoint to retrieve a list of valid output fields that can be returned

Use this endpoint to match contact information based on [input values](#dbaf31cd-0f7a-4bf3-b6c1-077f3c31f2df) and return the desired output fields in the response. Use [Contact Enrich Outputs](#28b47784-3186-4fc4-af91-12e6bc6fb31a) to retrieve the list of available output fields.

**Input combinations**

To match a contact, you must use one of the following combinations of parameters to construct your input:

- `personId` OR `emailAddress` OR `hashedEmail` OR `phone`. Because these values are unique to a single person, you can use any one of these values to search without providing any additional parameters. You can optionally combine one of these values with a `companyId`/`companyName`.
    
- `firstName` AND `lastName` AND `companyId`/`companyName`. Combining these values effectively results in a unique person.
    
- `fullName` AND `companyId`/`companyName`. Combining these values effectively results in a unique person.
    

**Maximum inputs per request**

You can input a maximum of 25 contacts in a single enrich request, returning the equivalent number of matching records. See the endpoint examples for how to build queries using multiple inputs.

**Required fields**

You can specify a list of required fields for each record returned. This supports all output fields and can be used as a comma-separated list. See the "Enrich contacts using required fields" example provided with this endpoint for sample JSON used for the request.

**Input params**

| Parameter | DataType | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| personId | Long integer or string | Unique ZoomInfo identifier for the contact |
| fullName | String | Contact full name |
| firstName | String | Contact first name |
| lastName | String | Contact last name |
| emailAddress | String | Business or Personal email address for the contact in [example@example.com](https://mailto:example@example.com) format |
| phone | String | Contact direct or mobile phone number |
| jobTitle | String | Contact title at current place of employment |
| hashedEmail | String | Hashed email value for the contact. Allows matching via an email address with the extra security of not exposing the email. Supported hash algorithms are: MD5, SHA1, SHA256 and SHA512. |
| externalURL | String | Social media URLs for the contact (e.g., Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn) |
| lastUpdatedDateAfter | String | The date after which the contact's profile was last updated in YYYY-MM-DD format |
| validDateAfter | String | The date after which the contact's profile was last validated in YYYY-MM-DD format |
| companyId | Long integer or string | Unique ZoomInfo identifier for the company |
| companyName | String | Name of the company for for which the contact works, or has worked |
| contactAccuracyScoreMin | Integer | Return contacts that meet the minimum accuracy score or higher |

**Output fields**

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| id | Unique ZoomInfo identifier for the contact |
| firstName | Contact first name |
| middleName | Contact middle name |
| lastName | Contact last name |
| email | Work email address for the contact in [example@example.com](https://mailto:example@example.com) format |
| hasCanadianEmail | Indicates whether the contact's email address is associated with a Canada domain |
| phone | Contact direct phone number |
| directPhoneDoNotCall | Contact flagged with "do not call" for direct phone |
| street | Street for the contact's work address |
| city | City for the contact's work address |
| region | State or province for the contact's work address |
| metroArea | Metro area for the contact's work address |
| zipCode | Zip Code or Postal Code for the contact's work address |
| state | State or province for the contact's work address |
| country | Country for the contact's work address |
| continent | Continent for the contact's work address |
| personHasMoved | Indicates ZoomInfo recognizes the contact does not match ZoomInfo's current company but does match known employment history |
| withinEu | Indicates whether the contact's work address is in Europe |
| withinCalifornia | Indicates whether the contact's work address is in California |
| withinCanada | Indicates whether the contact's work address is in Canada |
| validDate | Date on which the contact record was last validated |
| lastUpdatedDate | Date on which the contact record was last updated |
| noticeProvidedDate | Date on which the contact was notified of inclusion in ZoomInfo's database |
| salutation | Contact salutation |
| suffix | Contact suffix |
| jobTitle | Contact job title at current place of employment |
| jobFunction | Contact job function at current place of employment |
| education | Contact education details |
| hashedEmails | Contact MD5 encrypted email address(es) |
| picture | The URL which can be used to retrieve a photo for the contact |
| mobilePhoneDoNotCall | Contact flagged with "do not call" for mobile phone |
| externalUrls | Social media URLs for the contact (e.g., Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn) |
| employmentHistory | Contact employment history |
| managementLevel | Contact management level |
| contactAccuracyScore | This score indicates the likelihood that a contact is reachable and still employed by the company listed. Minimum score is 75 and maximum is 99. |
| companyId | Unique ZoomInfo identifier for a company |
| companyName | Name of the contact's current company |
| companyDescriptionList | List of descriptions associated with the contact's current company |
| companyPhone | Phone number of the company's primary address |
| companyFax | Fax number of the company's primary address |
| companyStreet | Street of the company's primary address |
| companyCity | City of the company's primary address |
| companyState | State or province of the company's primary address |
| companyZipCode | Zip Code or Postal Code of the company's primary address |
| companyCountry | Country of the company's primary address |
| companyContinent | Continent for the ccompany's primary address |
| companyLogo | The URL which can be used to retrieve the logo for the company |
| companyDivision | Contact primary division name at current place of employment |
| companySicCodes | The Standard Industrial Classification is a system for classifying industries by a four-digit code. |
| companyNaicsCodes | The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) is the standard used by Federal statistical agencies in classifying business establishments for the purpose of collecting, analyzing, and publishing statistical data related to the U.S. business economy. |
| companyWebsite | URL to the company website in [http://www.example.com](http://www.example.com) format |
| companyRevenue | Company revenue (e.g., $400 Million) |
| companyRevenueNumeric | Company revenue in raw number (e.g., 400 million is expressed as 400000000) |
| companyEmployeeCount | Employee count range |
| companyType | Company type (private, public, npo, education, government, other) |
| companyTicker | Company stock ticker symbol |
| companyRanking | Company ranking list (e.g., Fortune 500 and so on) |
| isDefunct | Indicates whether the company still exists |
| companySocialMediaUrls | Social media URLs for the company (e.g., Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn) |
| isCalifornia |  |
| isCanada |  |
| companyPrimaryIndustry | Top-level industry for a company |
| companyIndustries | The industry grouping for the company. A company can have multiple industries. |
| companyRevenueRange | Revenue range of the contact's current company |
| companyEmployeeRange | Employee range of the contact's current company |
| locationCompanyId | Company ID for the contact's location |
| positionStartDate | The date on which the contact began their current employment |
| yearsOfExperience | Years of overall experience |
| techSkills | List of technology skills identified for a contact |
| engagements | List of the contact's engagements. Includes the date and type of each engagement |
